content.short: PAWS is a rewards app that distributes tokens based on Telegram account history and ecosystem participation.
content.description: PAWS is a viral rewards application designed to recognize and reward users based on their historical activity within the Telegram and TON ecosystems. It analyzes factors such as Telegram account age and participation in major airdrops like Notcoin and Hamster Kombat to distribute tokens. By serving as a 'loyalty' layer for long-term Telegram users, PAWS has successfully attracted millions of participants, providing a simple and rewarding entry point for users to further engage with the decentralized services offered on TON.
content.meta: Get rewarded for your Telegram history with PAWS. Join the viral rewards app on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
